overview_description.description:
Payload CMS is a self-hosted, headless TypeScript CMS created with Node, React, and MongoDB. The platform secures data by implementing access control functions at the document or field level. Its field types are far more robust than any other headless CMS available. Dynamic fields such as Arrays and Blocks unleash incredible power, while purpose-built fields such as Relationship and GeoJSON enable extremely flexible data modeling.

Payload was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Michigan.

about_short_description.short_description: Payload CMS is a headless CMS and application framework designed to improve collaboration among developers, marketers, and product owners.

product.name: Payload CMS
product.description: An open-source headless CMS and application framework built on Next.js for managing and delivering content via APIs.

product.name: Payload Cloud
product.description: A proprietary SaaS platform providing cloud-hosted content management and backend website development services with subscription-based access.

product.name: Access Control
product.description: A code-driven, flexible access control system enabling granular user permissions and field-level data access within the CMS.

product.name: Localization
product.description: Native multilingual content management with field-level localization and internationalization support built into the CMS.

product.name: Authentication and Single Sign-On (SSO)
product.description: Built-in user authentication and enterprise-grade single sign-on integration for secure identity management.

product.name: Extensibility and Customization
product.description: A framework allowing developers to extend the admin UI with custom React components, add hooks, and create custom API endpoints.
